name: The Manhattan Plan
description: A borough-wide planning process led alongside the NYC Department of City Planning to identify strategies for adding 100,000 new homes to Manhattan over the next decade.

name: Cambridge, MA Housing Projections Model
description: A GIS-based housing projections model that informed the landmark elimination of single-family zoning districts in Cambridge, Massachusetts which the Boston Globe called “the most ambitious new zoning anywhere in the nation.”

name: Cooperative Works
description: A study of how to best use New York City’s Local Law 97 requirements to grow green jobs, retrofit the city’s building stock, and spur equitable post-pandemic recovery.

name: Getting filled in on Mayor Mamdani’s “Pothole Politics”
description: A data-led look at New York City potholes and what we can learn from the Mamdani administration’s first four “blitzes.”

name: USASCII
description: An ASCII visualization of U.S. land cover at a 30 kilometer resolution from 1985 – 2024.

name: NYC Open Data Visualization
description: Self-directed exploratory visualizations of New York City's Open Data from housing to urban heat and everything in between.
